sort.label: Chunk 1 of 6: Sort the rules
sort.todo: Categorize each rule in my-work/1-rule-sort.md as check, reviewer or both. R5 and R7 are done for you.

checks.label: Chunk 2 of 6: Build the checks
checks.todo: Run /plan-checks in Claude. It asks you three questions, then builds your checks in scripts/checks.py and the pre-commit hook.

reviewer.label: Chunk 3 of 6: Build the reviewer agent
reviewer.todo: Run /interview-reviewer in Claude. Then ./lab review try.
reviewer.done: It gives a verdict on every practice PR. Then: ./lab next

label.label: Chunk 4 of 6: Design the eval
label.todo: Run /design-eval in Claude. If it helps, have Claude walk you through a PR and its label first, with /explain-pr pr-01.
label.done: No TODOs left in my-work/4-eval-design.md. Then: ./lab next

eval.label: Chunk 5 of 6: Build the eval, improve the agent
eval.todo: Ask Claude to help you build your eval scorer. Then ./lab eval, improve the agent, and ./lab eval again.
eval.done: You can name what moved the score most. Then: ./lab holdout, for the fair test

holdout.label: Chunk 5 of 6, last step: Run the held-out PRs
holdout.todo: ./lab holdout runs and scores the held-out PRs. Read each error.
holdout.done: You've read the errors. Then: ./lab next

gate.label: Chunk 6 of 6: Add a human gate
gate.file: my-work/5-human-gate.md, and my-work/6-gate-agent.md if you choose a specialist
gate.todo: Read docs/human-review.md and decide who checks H4 to H6. H1 to H3 are done for you. Then ask Claude to build it.
gate.done: ./lab test-gate passes, and you've read human-review-queue.md after ./lab pipeline. That's the end of Part 2.
